Record Class YouTubeCredentials

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uno.anahata.asi.yam.tools.youtube.YouTubeCredentials
Record Components:
clientId - The Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client ID.
clientSecret - The Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client Secret.
refreshToken - The long-lived refresh token obtained after browser authorization.
playlistId - The default YouTube playlist ID (e.g. for Anahata-AGI-1 benchmark runs).
public record YouTubeCredentials(String clientId, String clientSecret, String refreshToken, String playlistId) extends Record
Encapsulates Google OAuth2 and YouTube Data API v3 credentials stored on disk.

Manages reading and writing client ID, client secret, long-lived refresh token, and default playlist ID in ~/.anahata/asi/youtube/credentials.json.

anahata
